cards.name: A Cat of Ill Omen
cards.officialText: FLIP: Choose 1 Trap from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck, or, if "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add that Trap to your hand instead.

cards.name: An Owl of Luck
cards.officialText: FLIP: Select 1 Field Spell Card from your Deck and place it on top of your Deck. If "Necrovalley" is on the field, you can add the selected Field Spell Card to your hand instead.

implementation.selectionTiming: resolution, not target selection at activation
implementation.necrovalleyAlternative: optional hand choice only when Necrovalley is face-up at resolution; deck-top remains a legal choice
implementation.shuffle: caller receives shuffleDeck=true only for a Deck-to-hand move
implementation.privacy: searches only the active physical seat's Deck; partner reserves are not read
implementation.identity: moves original CardRef object and preserves physical UID

coverage: optional Necrovalley hand branch for both cards

limitations: This is a card-specific adapter over M368's generic primitive, not yet registered in monsterEffects.ts or duelEngineCurrent.ts.
M61 handoff remains pending; no resolver integration, catalog admission, certification, distribution allowlist, inventory or production changes.
Discord/gateway is not invoked by this unit layer.
